_comment: Configuration file for CSV/MD conversion scripts
_instructions: This file controls which files should be processed by the conversion scripts.
- Set 'files_to_process' to ['all'] to process all .md or .csv files under docs_dir
- Or specify individual file names (without extension) in the array
- File names are case-sensitive and should match exactly (without .md or .csv extension)
- Set 'table_format' to 'max_width' for tables with column widths matching content (original format)
- Or set 'table_format' to 'compact' for minimal-width tables
